title: UniPASE confirmation
intro: Last check before UniPASE becomes the remaster chain. Each clip has two versions in random order, the original and UniPASE, matched in loudness; pick the one you would rather hear for a whole talk. Clips 1-5 are the defect test clips (muffled, heavy hiss, room, quiet, hum); 6-15 are muffled talks it was never tuned on; 16-17 are clean grade A/B recordings, to hear whether UniPASE helps, hurts or does nothing on good audio; 18-21 are the multilingual section: consecutive Persian/English translation, Persian alone, Arabic/Persian chanting, and Spanish. Their word check in Reveal uses Whisper in that language (auto-detect for the mixed clips). Of the clips you already heard, Muhajir 1963 (clip 3) opens with about 10 s of Persian before the English. Reveal shows the word difference and bandwidth.

desc.unipase: UniPASE (2026, low-hallucination generative restoration, 48 kHz), full strength, run on boss's GPU
